title: School scoliosis screen: slide a scoliometer down a manikin's back, notch on the spine, both feet on; refer at 7 deg
instruction: Screen the training manikin's back with the scoliometer: notch on the spine, both feet on the back, slide it from the shoulders to the waist; put the slip in REFER if it reads 7 degrees or more, else PASS. Then put the scoliometer back in its case.
context: Registered nurses (O*NET 29-1141.00, 3,282,010 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2024), school nurses among them, screen adolescents for scoliosis with the Adams forward-bend test and a scoliometer (Bunnell 1984): the instrument is laid across the back, notch over the spine, both ends on the skin, and slid from the upper thoracic to the lumbar spine; the largest angle of trunk rotation is noted and 7 deg or more is referred (Bunnell 1993; AAFP 2001). A notch off the spine, a lifted end or a hand that tilts the instrument misreads the hump: missed curves progress untreated, false referrals cost radiographs.
setup: Station table; positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y to the robot's left, heights above the bench), arm bases at y +-30.5. Manikin: a rigid adolescent back bent forward (skin sRGB 222, 178, 150), back up, on a dark (45, 47, 50) stand 36 x 26 x 3 cm, 20 kg, loose. Spine along x at y -12, shoulders at x 18, waist at x 52; the paraspinal skin level on the spine line is 8.0 cm up at both ends and rises as a half sine to 10.2 cm at x 35. Across the back: a spinous-process ridge 5 mm proud, paraspinal muscles 5 mm proud 2.5 cm either side, then the ribs fall away at 5 deg, flanks rounded, 27 cm wide. The skin shell rides on a 1,500 N/m vertical spring (padded manikin). One thoracic level carries a rib hump: the back is rotated about the spine by the angle of trunk rotation, peak 3 to 11 deg (never 6 to 8) at x 27 to 36, fading over about 5 cm either way, either side; the seed sets it. Screening span: x 22 (upper thoracic) to 47 (lumbar). Scoliometer: OSI (Bunnell) Scoliometer, white plate 19.0 x 8.9 cm, 1.0 cm thick, 80 g; two rounded feet at its ends, a 3.0 cm wide, 2.4 cm high notch in the middle of its bottom edge; on its face a pale blue tube (14 cm radius) holding an 8 mm dark ball, a 0-30 deg scale each way in 1 deg ticks and a red zero mark; two 8 mm finger pads at the top centre, one each face, 8.1 cm above the feet. It stands upright on its feet in an open dark blue (30, 50, 110) case (slot 1.8 cm wide, walls 3.5 cm high, 400 g, loose) centred at x 24, y -37, long axis along y, scale facing the robots. Slip: a white block 3 x 6 x 4.5 cm with a yellow card on top, 40 g, at x 22, y 22. Trays, 12 x 12 cm inside, 2 cm walls, 300 g, loose: red (200, 45, 40) REFER at x 34, y 33; green (40, 150, 70) PASS at x 34, y 15.
scoring: Score 0 if at any point the load on the manikin's back exceeds 20 N, the scoliometer falls off the table, or the manikin moves more than 20 mm. Contact: a foot within 1.5 mm of the skin. 0.25 when the control steps with both feet in contact, the notch within 10 mm of the spine line and the plate within 20 deg of square to the spine cover at least 60% of the 25 cm screening span (5 mm bins, upper thoracic to lumbar). 0.5 when, in addition, those steps cover every bin within 20 mm of the hump's peak level and both feet were in contact for at least 90% of the steps with a foot on the back inside the span. 0.75 when, in addition, the slip block rests wholly inside the correct tray: REFER if the peak angle of trunk rotation is 7 deg or more, else PASS. 1.0 (success, held 1 s) when, in addition, the scoliometer stands in its case and no gripper centre is within 5 cm of it or of the slip.
reset_notes: Stand the scoliometer back in its case on its feet, scale toward the robots, and the slip block at x 22, y 22; put the trays back. Set the back for the seed (seed mod 8 picks one of eight backs). Real trial: re-glue the EVA rib-hump overlay at the seeded level and side and check its angle by hand with the scoliometer.
fidelity: PhysX 240 Hz. Back drawn as a smooth mesh; collided as overlapping 12 mm capsules within 0.7 mm of it, on a sprung shell whose spring gives the load. Eight backs are built; the seed picks one, the others are parked off the table. Ball: a damped 14 cm pendulum (the tube). Finger pads are 8 mm sphere contacts, so the plate rolls freely in the fingers. Contact, notch and coverage are scored from geometry. Plate thickness, masses, skin friction and stiffness are estimates.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (2,400 steps, seed 0); scripted demo: 1.0 (seeds 0-7, 4 REFER and 4 PASS backs, success at step 972); do nothing, random joints, random reaches (2 seeds each), slip in REFER without measuring, single placement at mid-back: 0.0
